newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp opens two new Calif. offices.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp opens two new Calif. offices.

text.p: PacifiCorp said Thursday it has expanded its presence in California by opening new offices in Pasadena and San Ramon.

"These offices are strategically located in the northern and southern parts of the state to provide customers with long-term, easy access to PacifiCorp engineering, technical and support expertise," Alex Miller, vice president, said.
PacifiCorp, based in Portland, Ore., is gearing up to market power to customers in California, which will allow open competition between electricity suppliers starting in January.
